title: How to reset your password
content: Go to the login page and click 'Forgot password'. A reset link is emailed within 5 minutes. Links expire after 30 minutes.

title: Billing and failed payments
content: Failed payments are retried automatically 3 times over 5 days. Customers can update their card under Account > Billing > Payment Methods.

title: Order and shipping status
content: Shipping orders receive a tracking number by email once dispatched. Delivery typically takes 5-7 business days domestically.

title: Upgrading or downgrading your plan
content: Plan changes take effect immediately and are billed pro-rata. Cancellations take effect at the end of the current billing cycle.

title: API rate limits
content: Free plan: 60 requests/hour. Pro plan: 1000 requests/hour. Enterprise: custom limits, contact your account manager.

title: Data export and account deletion
content: Data exports can be requested under Account > Privacy > Export Data, delivered within 48 hours. Account deletion is permanent after a 14-day grace period.
